# Your Chinese Astrology

> > Comprehensive guide to Chinese astrology, zodiac signs, feng shui, palmistry, face reading, and traditional Chinese divination practices.

Your Chinese Astrology provides detailed information on the 12 Chinese zodiac animals (Rat, Ox, Tiger, Rabbit, Dragon, Snake, Horse, Sheep, Monkey, Rooster, Dog, Pig), their elemental variations, yearly horoscopes, compatibility, career guidance, feng shui principles, palmistry, dream interpretation, and Chinese cultural festivals tied to the lunar calendar.

## Key Topics

- Chinese Zodiac
- 12 Zodiac Animals (Rat, Ox, Tiger, Rabbit, Dragon, Snake, Horse, Sheep, Monkey, Rooster, Dog, Pig)
- Five Elements (Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth)
- Yearly Horoscopes and 2026 Predictions
- Zodiac Compatibility
- Feng Shui
- Palmistry and Hand Reading
- Face Reading
- Lunar Calendar and Chinese Festivals
- Dream Interpretation
- Birth Hour Fate Analysis
- Chinese Naming Traditions
- Wealth and Career Fortune
- Personality Traits by Zodiac
